title: Function tools with the default reasoning effort
summary: The caller requests a function tool without setting reasoning effort, and Chat Completions rejects the combination.

messages.content: How long is a 10 km run in miles? Use the tool to convert it.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a value from one unit to another.

requirements.text: The library surfaces the API error or refuses the call through validation before sending it.

grading_notes: gpt-6-luna answers function tools on Chat Completions with a 400 error (param: reasoning_effort) unless the request sets reasoning_effort: "none". The default effort applies when the caller sets none. The library must surface an API error or refuse the call before sending it through validation; it must not crash, hang or return a result. Sending the call to another endpoint, such as /v1/responses, grades HARNESS because this scenario has no fixture for it.
